whisper.transcript: If you put a motor inside a dead bird, you could make it fly again. Researchers built drones using preserved bird bodies, with machinery hidden underneath the feathers. A gearbox turns the motor's spinning motion into flapping wings. The goal is to watch wildlife with less disturbance. And they've built a swimming robot using a preserved duck. So the bird watching the birds might already be dead.
